description: Managed solution for Test and Production (v1.1.0). Built from Dev unmanaged via pac solution pack/export.
buildInstructions: 1. Complete SharePoint install/upgrade to 1.1.0 in target env first (data plane)
2. In Dev: pac solution export --name HVCGOS --managed false --path ./src/power-platform/exports/HVCGOS_unmanaged_1.1.0.zip
3. pac solution pack from source OR clone as managed: pac solution export --managed true
4. Copy managed zip to releases/v1.1.0/artifacts/ (do not overwrite releases/v1.0.0/)
6. Prod: same managed zip after Test approval
